title: a vendored markdown file was not prettier-stable, and a project hook rewrote it
body:
# 0008: a vendored markdown file was not prettier-stable, and a project hook rewrote it

## Tags

install, manifest, prettier, WP-11, fixed-pending-close

## Summary

`lib/tmpl/help.md` -- the one Markdown file in devbin's vendored half -- shipped with hand-wrapped paragraphs. Lamplight's pre-commit hook runs `prettier --write` over every staged `.md`, and Lamplight's `.prettierrc.json` sets `proseWrap: never`, which JOINS wrapped paragraphs. So the INSTALL COMMIT itself rewrote a vendored file, and the very next `devbin doctor` failed the manifest check:

```
FAIL  manifest: vendored files have been edited in place
```

The system worked -- doctor made the corruption loud within one command -- but the install..doctor window carried a manifest that lied, and an unattended flow (install + commit + no doctor) would have carried it indefinitely.

## Why only Lamplight

The exposure needs BOTH a hook that formats staged markdown AND a config that changes the template's shape. Laksa and Conflab format staged markdown but have no `.prettierrc` (prettier defaults `proseWrap: preserve`, under which the hand-wrapped template is stable); Baize has the `proseWrap: never` config but its hook runs no prettier. Lamplight has both.

## The fix, two levels

1. **Devbin (this commit): the template's paragraphs are unwrapped** -- one line per paragraph, the same stable form every WP-11 help topic uses, unchanged under BOTH `preserve` and `never`. Any Markdown devbin ever ships in its vendored half must be authored in this form; that is now the rule, and this file is its only current instance.
2. **Lamplight (project-side): `.prettierignore` gains `bin/.devbin/lib/`** -- the vendored half is manifest-checksummed and is not the project's to format, the exact argument Lamplight's own ignore file already makes for `design/system/**` ("verbatim material must not be reformatted by a tool run for an unrelated purpose, and the fidelity guarantee must not depend on the prettier config staying put"). The stability fix makes today's template safe; the ignore line makes the GUARANTEE independent of the template staying that way.

Laksa/Baize/Conflab are safe by configuration today; whether the structural ignore line rolls fleet-wide is hv's call at WP-11 close.

## Found by

The Lamplight install commit (WP-11, 2026-08-09) -- the ninth base defect found by a migration asking the base a question it had not been asked, and the first one DOCTOR caught live rather than a probe.

## A reporting oddity noticed during the fix

The plain `upgrade` correctly refused the edited file and doctor kept failing (the WP-13 compose-fix working in the wild -- the old code would have re-checksummed the edit into the manifest). But the subsequent `upgrade --force` reported `0 added, 0 updated, 27 unchanged` and "Already up to date" while the end state shows the file WAS brought back to source between the two runs -- the counters read as manifest-relative, not action-relative. End state was verified by `cmp` + doctor, not by the tool's chatter. Worth a look at what the counter counts; tenth-candidate, low.

## Close condition

Template unwrapped + re-vendored across all four projects (their doctors green), Lamplight's ignore line landed, and a devbin-side check that ships no unstable Markdown (a test running `prettier --prose-wrap never --check` over lib/**/*.md, or a decline with reason).

## Resolution (2026-08-09, all three parts landed)

Template unwrapped at source and re-vendored fleet-wide same day (`9e760af`; all four doctors green). The devbin-side check is `tests/unit/vendoredmd.bats` (Devbin `2a722d1`): a sweep over `lib/**/*.md` failing on any hard-wrapped paragraph -- the structural form of the prettier invocation named above, chosen because it needs no prettier on PATH and both proseWrap modes are stable exactly when no paragraph spans two prose lines; fence-aware, loud on an empty sweep, and the detector carries its own red check. The fleet `.prettierignore` roll landed with the WP-11 close re-vendors: Lamplight already fenced (`3857ddeda`), Conflab `8949cd97` and Laksa `ace8f391` gained the fence file, Baize `75b6773` appended it to its existing one -- live protection there, since Baize also formats markdown with proseWrap: never. The `--force` counter oddity remains a tenth-candidate, low, unfiled.
